nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point: POST /enquiry from the website form. Payload arrives nested under .body

nodes.name: normalise
nodes.notes: Any channel -> ONE canonical envelope. Everything downstream reads only this shape

nodes.name: facts
nodes.notes: The fact table. The reply may assert NOTHING outside this. Mirror of kb/facts.yaml

nodes.name: build classify request
nodes.notes: Builds the Bedrock Converse payload. Schema + instructions live here. Forced tool call = structured JSON

nodes.name: classify
nodes.notes: Amazon Nova 2 Lite on Bedrock (Converse). URL + model from `config`. Synthetic data only

nodes.name: parse classification
nodes.notes: Reads the tool call + tokens; cost from `config` prices. On PARSE FAILED, the summary shows stopReason + response keys

nodes.name: select facts
nodes.notes: Only this category's facts. Smaller prompt, cheaper, and 'grounded on' means something

nodes.name: build draft request
nodes.notes: Bedrock Converse payload. The grounding rules live here - only <facts>, no invented prices

nodes.name: draft
nodes.notes: Amazon Nova 2 Lite on Bedrock (Converse). Plain-text reply. Synthetic data only

nodes.name: prepare row
nodes.notes: All three branches land here. Flatten to one DB row; cost = classify + draft (if any)

nodes.name: insert enquiry
nodes.notes: Parameterised insert. ON CONFLICT makes a re-delivered enquiry a no-op

parameters.content:
## Enquiry Desk — what this does

A customer enquiry arrives. It is **classified**, answered **only from a fact table it cannot
deviate from**, and recorded — with cost tracked per enquiry.

**The business problem.** Meridian Tutors (fictional) is staffed from the UK, 09:00–18:00 UTC.
Its customers are in Hong Kong, Singapore and Malaysia — UTC+8. Those UK hours are 17:00–02:00
local, so **the entire Asian business day is unstaffed.** A parent asking a question at 10am
local waits seven hours, while emailing two competitors.

**The flow**

`form → envelope → classify → derive slots → route → (auto_send: select facts → draft) → record`

**The design decision worth defending:** grounding comes from a **structured fact table, not RAG**.
It is auditable, cheaper, and it cannot invent a price. A tutoring company can survive a slow
reply; it cannot survive quoting a discount that does not exist.

**Cost:** ~$0.001 per enquiry — both model calls run on Amazon Nova 2 Lite (Bedrock),
priced in the `config` node. Measured over 24 test cases, not estimated.

⚠️ **Session 2 in progress** — see the red note for what is still missing.

### ① INTAKE → ENVELOPE
Normalise first, branch never.
Every later node reads one shape,
so adding email intake later
changes nothing downstream.

### ② UNDERSTAND
Cheap model, strict schema.
Returns category + confidence +
missing slots + safety flags.
Confidence and flags are what
session 2 routes on.

### ③ GROUND & DRAFT
Pass only the facts this category
needs, then forbid everything else.
Grounding is enforced by what you
*send*, not by asking nicely.

### ④ RECORD
run_log is where your portfolio
numbers come from: cost, latency
and model per stage.
Nothing is emailed. By design.

## ⚠️ Not finished — session 2 of 3 in progress

**Missing on purpose:**

- **Routing is in** (`route`: flags → sensitive → vague → missing slots → auto_send), 19/24 actions
  right. **Missing: the second gate** — *can the facts answer it?* — so a bundle price or a booking
  change still routes to auto_send. Clarify branch records, but doesn't write its one question yet.
- **No validator.** Nothing yet stops an invented price reaching the draft.
- **Retries are on** (4 tries per model call), but **no dead-letter or alerts** yet — session 3.
- **Nothing is sent.** Replies are drafted and stored only. **Keep it that way until the
  escalation gate exists.**

**Next:** the second gate after `draft`: if `<facts>` don't cover the enquiry → escalate.

parameters.query:
insert into run_log (enquiry_id, stage, status, attempt, model, cost_usd)
select $1::uuid, 'classify', 'ok', 1, $2, $3::numeric
union all
select $1::uuid, 'draft', 'ok', 1, $2, $4::numeric where $5::text = 'auto_send';

nodes.name: insert run_log
nodes.notes: One row per model call: classify always, draft only on auto_send

nodes.name: config
nodes.notes: Model settings in ONE place. Swap provider = edit this node

nodes.name: derive missing slots
nodes.notes: Model says what the customer SAID; this rule table decides what's MISSING. Testable, no model judgement

nodes.name: route
nodes.notes: First match wins. Flags above everything: a flag at 0.99 confidence still escalates. Confidence is NOT used

nodes.name: action = escalate
nodes.notes: No AI draft: a human writes this one

nodes.name: action = clarify
nodes.notes: One-question reply comes later (session 2). For now: recorded, not drafted

nodes.name: action = auto_send
nodes.notes: Provisional: the second gate (can <facts> answer it?) can still escalate. Nothing is sent yet

nodes.name: read draft
nodes.notes: Pulls the reply text + tokens out of the Converse response and puts our data back
